error: The page says the country figures sum to the headline before refunds; both are net of refunds.
warning_texts: release/report.md line 22 says the country figures add up to the headline before refunds, but per the registry they add up to net revenue after refunds (35741.52); the pre-refund total is 40235.02, so the only reader-visible reconciliation sentence contradicts the 'net of refunds' caveat under each

Both release gates passed with that false sentence on the page, because audit/check_plan.json has no rule that reads prose assertions in the report, only anchored numbers, claim presence and caveat strings.

Neither release gate records a numeric recompute in its checks.json: gate_release_machine has only release_surface_gate.json (registry-equality binding), and gate_release_document has presence checks only, so this auditor's recompute is the only arithmetic check at the release stage.
release/dashboard_data.json shows the three country cards and the headline card but says nothing about them reconciling, so a dashboard reader can't see that they add up to the headline.
In release/report.md line 11 the refund-rate numerator and denominator are shown as a bare '27 of 57' with no unit; that they count paying customers is stated only in the caveat line above.

metrics/calculated_metrics.json names the period '2025-Q1-delivered' while the period frozen in audit_spec.yaml ends on 2025-03-30, not 2025-03-31, so any label calling it the quarter implies a day the population excludes.
summary: All 21 rendered numbers on report.md, dashboard_data.json and the manifest match the registry at their display precision, country figures sum to net_revenue (35741.52), refund_rate recomputes as 27/57 = 0.473684, caveats are visible and no UNVERIFIED_CLAIM marker exists; but release/report.md line 22 tells the reader the country figures add up to the headline before refunds, which is false (before refunds the total is 40235.02), so the one reader-visible statement of the reconciliation contradicts the numbers and caveats beside it.
